the_clock_anchor.the_source: DERIVED from the bundle's own wall stamps
the_clock_anchor.the_note: the walkabout's start, recovered from the audio parts' and the room measures' own wall clocks. meta.startedAt is the SESSION's creation time, which here is 435.840 s earlier, and it is NOT the origin of the frames' t.

the_tier_meaning: the room-lens's tier is its ADAPTIVE FIDELITY mode, chosen from the PHONE's own motion -- STILL is 128 cols at 8 fps, SLOW is 96 at 15, MOVING is 64 at 30. It says the phone was not moving; it does NOT say the room was still.
the_ramp_note: the room-lens's ACTUAL ramp: 17 glyphs whose top 8 are all '@', so half the brightness range carries no information in the picture
the_units: the room-lens's own brightness: a 2.2x contrast stretch of the camera luma, clipped, with each glyph read as the LOWER edge of its band

the_grid.note: the phone's change maps are computed at the phone's native resolution and THEN reduced to the corpus's grid by area averaging

change.note: the ABSOLUTE difference between consecutive frames, in the room-lens's own BRIGHTNESS units (a 2.2x contrast stretch of the camera luma, clipped), and each glyph is read as the LOWER edge of its band, so every value here is a lower bound on the true difference

luma_grid.note: the picture reduced to the corpus's 40x24 grid, so the luma render has a phone side to show

the_noise_of_this_sensor.the_rule: the phone's RESOLUTION: one brightness band, because below one band the rendering cannot express a change at all
the_noise_of_this_sensor.the_note: the phone renders a POSTERISED picture -- 17 glyphs, the top 8 of them all '@' -- so its change map is a MASK of band flips, not the same KIND of quantity as the ProArt's. The floor is the smallest change it can express; the duty cycle is how often it expresses one, and a channel that is on most of the time cannot time a movement.

the_pose.the_note: the device orientation attached to every frame
